messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: SQL schema ignored in ODBC DSN
parts:
I've probably not got all the possible combinations for all of the types of databases working correctly in Rattle for every case yet.

As a work-around, copy the command out of the log and paste it into the console, then add the schema and save the result into "ds" for example (rather than crs$dataset). Then choose to load ds as an R Dataset into Rattle.

Hope that helps.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com


On 15 February 2013 23:05, Francois Botha <igi...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I'm a new user to rattle. I immediately tried to connect through ODBC DSN to our SQL server. The table of value is e.g. MySchema.MyTable. Rattle populated all the table names, but omitted the schema. I therefore could not successfully continue. In the log, I could see that the schema was omitted and the query that was generated was "SELECT * FROM MyTable" instead of "SELECT * FROM MySchema.MyTable"

regards
Francois
